reference: 来湖州旅游不但能欣赏到绿水青山
english: Visiting Huzhou, you can not only enjoy clear rivers and green mountains
expected_finetuned: 到湖州旅游不但能欣赏到绿水青山
finetuned_note: Small slip: 来 ("come to") became 到 ("go to"). The meaning is unchanged.
baseline: 到5G的利益,不得能给新商家了水清洗

reference: 记者来到湖州市机动车驾驶考试服务中心
english: A reporter visited the Huzhou Motor Vehicle Driving Test Center

baseline: 這裡到5G日期中處加斯科斯佛重型

reference: 这位老人叫席中科今年94岁了
english: This elderly man is named Xi Zhongke, and he is 94 years old this year
expected_finetuned: 这位老人叫薛中科今年94岁
finetuned_note: Misheard the surname 席 (Xi) as 薛 (Xue) and dropped the final particle 了.
baseline: 这个老人家叫中科,跟你讲就是手术
baseline_note: Starts roughly right ("this old man is called Zhongke"), then turns into gibberish ("let me tell you, it's surgery").

reference: 喜欢游古镇的乌镇西塘离湖州都很近
